evals.name: one-sided-wipes-mardu
evals.prompt: my commander deck is Edgar Markov (mardu, lots of vampire tokens). I want board wipes that hit my opponents' creatures but leave mine alone, or at least hurt them way more than me. give me 5-8 good options
evals.expected_output: 5-8 Commander-legal cards within W/B/R identity that sweep opponents' creatures while sparing or favoring yours, each backed by quoted oracle text, with any catch called out.

evals.name: cheap-draw-orzhov
evals.prompt: looking for card draw for my Killian, Ink Duelist deck (orzhov). needs to be mana value 3 or less, and i'd rather have stuff that keeps drawing over a one-shot. what are my best options?
evals.expected_output: W/B Commander-legal cards with mana value <= 3 that draw cards, repeatable engines preferred, each verified by quoted oracle text.

evals.name: land-ramp-budget
evals.prompt: need green ramp for a commander deck on a budget, under 2 dollars each. only stuff that puts lands onto the battlefield, no mana dorks or rocks. list like 8 picks
evals.expected_output: About 8 green Commander-legal spells/permanents that put land cards onto the battlefield (not creatures/artifacts that tap for mana), priced under $2 USD, each verified by quoted oracle text.
